title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Preview files directly in the web client
summary: This blog series covers methods to preview various file types (PDF, images, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, video, and more) directly in the Business Central web client without downloading or using custom control add-ins, with native support expanding through BC26 and BC27 releases.
key_points: PDF attachments can be previewed natively in BC26 web client without control add-ins or APIs
Images and Base64-encoded images can be previewed directly in the web client with enlargement capability
SharePoint-hosted files (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, CSV, MP4) are supported for preview within Business Central
BC27 introduces a new Document ExtendedDataType that displays PDFs as portrait images in FactBox controls
Word documents can be previewed in the web client without downloading files

quotes.text: Preview PDF attachments directly in web client (No control add-in and APIs)

quotes.text: Most file types supported for previewing files in SharePoint

quotes.text: Support for new ExtendedDataType value: Document (display/preview a PDF as a portrait image in FactBox)
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates BC27's new native data type specifically designed for document display in UI components
